aggregate.description: Event-sourced aggregate tracking stock for one product variant at one warehouse.
aggregate.name: InventoryItem

inventory.stock.expiry.ExpireStaleReserv.description: Release reservations older than the specified threshold.
inventory.stock.expiry.ExpireStaleReserv.name: ExpireStaleReservations

inventory.stock.initialization.Initializ.description: Create a new inventory record for a product variant at a warehouse.
inventory.stock.initialization.Initializ.name: InitializeStock

inventory.stock.receiving.ReceiveStock.description: Record incoming stock received at the warehouse.
inventory.stock.receiving.ReceiveStock.name: ReceiveStock

inventory.stock.reservation.ConfirmReser.description: Confirm a stock reservation after order payment.
inventory.stock.reservation.ConfirmReser.name: ConfirmReservation

inventory.stock.returns.ReturnToStock.description: Add returned items back to inventory.
inventory.stock.returns.ReturnToStock.name: ReturnToStock

inventory.stock.shipping.CommitStock.description: Commit reserved stock when an order ships.
inventory.stock.shipping.CommitStock.name: CommitStock

inventory.stock.stock.Reservation.description:
A hold on inventory for a specific order.

Reservations transition through: Active → Confirmed → (committed via
CommitStock), or Active → Released (cancelled/expired).
inventory.stock.stock.Reservation.name: Reservation

inventory.stock.events.DamagedStockWritt.description: Damaged stock was written off (removed from inventory).
inventory.stock.events.DamagedStockWritt.name: DamagedStockWrittenOff

inventory.stock.events.LowStockDetected.description: Available stock dropped below the reorder point.
inventory.stock.events.LowStockDetected.name: LowStockDetected

inventory.stock.events.ReservationConfir.description: A stock reservation was confirmed after order payment.
inventory.stock.events.ReservationConfir.name: ReservationConfirmed

inventory.stock.events.ReservationReleas.description: A stock reservation was released, returning quantity to available.
inventory.stock.events.ReservationReleas.name: ReservationReleased

inventory.stock.events.StockAdjusted.description: Stock was manually adjusted (count, shrinkage, correction).
inventory.stock.events.StockAdjusted.name: StockAdjusted

inventory.stock.events.StockCheckRecorde.description: A physical stock count was recorded.
inventory.stock.events.StockCheckRecorde.name: StockCheckRecorded

inventory.stock.events.StockCommitted.description: Reserved stock was committed (shipped), reducing on-hand quantity.
inventory.stock.events.StockCommitted.name: StockCommitted

inventory.stock.events.StockInitialized.description: A new inventory record was created for a product variant at a warehouse.
inventory.stock.events.StockInitialized.name: StockInitialized

inventory.stock.events.StockMarkedDamage.description: Stock was identified as damaged, moving from on-hand to damaged.
inventory.stock.events.StockMarkedDamage.name: StockMarkedDamaged

inventory.stock.events.StockReceived.description: Stock was received into the warehouse, increasing on-hand quantity.
inventory.stock.events.StockReceived.name: StockReceived

inventory.stock.events.StockReserved.description: Stock was reserved for an order, decreasing available quantity.
inventory.stock.events.StockReserved.name: StockReserved

inventory.stock.events.StockReturned.description: Returned items were added back to on-hand inventory.
inventory.stock.events.StockReturned.name: StockReturned

inventory.stock.stock.StockLevels.description:
Tracks all stock quantities.

Available is always equal to on_hand - reserved. It is denormalized
here for query convenience.
inventory.stock.stock.StockLevels.name: StockLevels

aggregate.description: A physical location where inventory is stored.
aggregate.name: Warehouse

inventory.warehouse.management.AddZone.description: Add a zone to a warehouse.
inventory.warehouse.management.AddZone.name: AddZone

inventory.warehouse.management.RemoveZon.description: Remove a zone from a warehouse.
inventory.warehouse.management.RemoveZon.name: RemoveZone

inventory.warehouse.warehouse.Zone.description: A logical area within a warehouse (e.g., cold storage, hazmat).
inventory.warehouse.warehouse.Zone.name: Zone

inventory.warehouse.events.ZoneAdded.description: A zone was added to a warehouse.
inventory.warehouse.events.ZoneAdded.name: ZoneAdded

inventory.warehouse.events.ZoneRemoved.description: A zone was removed from a warehouse.
inventory.warehouse.events.ZoneRemoved.name: ZoneRemoved

inventory.stock.catalogue_subscriber.Cat.description:
Reacts to VariantAdded events to initialize inventory records.

ACL pattern: receives raw broker message dict, extracts event type from
metadata.headers.type, and dispatches an InitializeStock command with
default warehouse and quantity settings. Ignores all other event types.
inventory.stock.catalogue_subscriber.Cat.name: CatalogueVariantSubscriber

inventory.stock.fulfillment_subscriber.F.description:
Reacts to Fulfillment domain events to commit reserved stock.

ACL pattern: receives raw broker message dict, extracts event type from
metadata.headers.type, and dispatches CommitStock commands. Ignores all
event types not relevant to the Inventory domain.
inventory.stock.fulfillment_subscriber.F.name: FulfillmentEventsSubscriber

inventory.stock.ordering_subscriber.Orde.description:
Reacts to Ordering domain events to manage stock reservations and returns.

ACL pattern: receives raw broker message dict, extracts event type from
metadata.headers.type, and dispatches appropriate commands. Ignores all
event types not relevant to the Inventory domain.
inventory.stock.ordering_subscriber.Orde.name: OrderingEventsSubscriber
